product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines atmospheric observations from autonomous weather balloons with AI models to provide weather forecasts and decision tools for individuals, enterprises, and government agencies.
product_one_liner.notes: The balloon-based observations and AI forecasts are described at https://windbornesystems.com/careers/enterprise-account-executive----utilities and https://windbornesystems.com/products/forecasts. The homepage identifies individual and enterprise audiences and decision tools; https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure establishes government use.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link or public plan page appears in the navigation or footer of https://windbornesystems.com/, and the /pricing URL did not yield a page. https://api.windbornesystems.com/getting-started directs users to contact the company for full commercial access.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-wins-u-s-navy-air-force-awards-to-accelerate-its-groundbreaking-ai-weather-forecasting-models-and-enable-operational-govt-models explicitly calls NOAA an operational customer and describes a six-month forecasting-development contract with the U.S. Navy. The Navy is included as a contracting customer, not merely because it is called a partner. | named_customers.0: The company's Navy/Air Force awards article explicitly identifies NOAA as an operational customer since early 2023. | named_customers.1: The article describes a six-month contract with the U.S. Navy to expand WeatherMesh forecasting capabilities, supporting its classification as a government contracting customer.

employee_band.notes: The profile at https://tracxn.com reports 101 employees, and https://linkedin.com/company/windborne reports 103, both supporting 101-200. Confidence is reduced because https://leadiq.com/c/windborne-systems/5e4c10e1626d3b6fe04c22f7/employee-directory gives an approximate October 2026 count of 98, just across the band boundary.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: https://www.windbornesystems.com/careers/growth-lead gives the office address as 1600 Bridge Parkway, Redwood City, CA. The homepage, https://windbornesystems.com/, describes the base more specifically as Redwood Shores. | hq_country: https://windbornesystems.com/ identifies the company's base as Redwood Shores, California; the country is normalized to United States.

founded_year.notes: The company profile at https://tracxn.com reports a founding year of 2019.

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying engineer-authored posts explain product construction: Haoxing Du's WeatherMesh architecture article at https://www.windbornesystems.com/blog/weathermesh-4-technical-blog and Jack Michaels's encoding-and-assimilation article at https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-ai-da.

public_docs.notes: https://api.windbornesystems.com/ is a public documentation portal with model information and Getting Started material. https://api.windbornesystems.com/getting-started also provides authentication, library, interpolated-forecast, and gridded-forecast guides and links to further documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/windborne-systems/17c1e7b1-1a8d-4bfd-bd25-3ae48641b642 is a live Machine Learning Research Engineer, Model Evaluation posting with an application link.

model_provider.value: WindBorne's proprietary WeatherMesh models, including WeatherMesh-6 Global and WM-6 3km, and its MetaMesh blended forecasting model.
model_provider.notes: https://windbornesystems.com/products/forecasts explicitly names WeatherMesh-6 Global, WM-6 3km, and MetaMesh, and explains that MetaMesh blends WeatherMesh with public AI and numerical weather-prediction models.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal page at https://windbornesystems.com/ext/legal contains terms, privacy, and cookie policies but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS. The empty list describes that page, not an assertion that the company has no certifications anywhere.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure explicitly identifies the round as Series B. | funding_date: The round announcement at https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure is dated August 5, 2026, yielding 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified round announcement, https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure, reports a $37 million round, equivalent to USD 37000000; this is the round amount, not cumulative funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 Series B announcement at https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure falls within the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/windborne-systems/7c7c60c2-d068-4808-8288-c65e3f98a2f0 is a live Enterprise Account Executive — Utilities posting with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: https://windbornesystems.com/blog lists the October 29, 2026 announcement at https://windbornesystems.com/blog/introducing-windborne-weather-events, stating that the previously internal Weather Events tracker is now available through the API. This falls within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The selected leaders shown at https://windbornesystems.com/careers and the available executive profiles did not establish a qualifying appointment or departure in the window, nor provide an exhaustive dated roster sufficient to conclude false.
